titleZh: FM9003 充电升压二合一 PMIC 开放样片申请
titleEn: FM9003 Charger + Boost PMIC Now Sampling
excerptZh: 单颗芯片集成 1A 线性充电与 5V/1A 同步升压，外围仅需 6 个元件。
excerptEn: A single die combining a 1A linear charger and 5V/1A synchronous boost, with only six external components.
bodyZh:
## 一颗芯片解决充电与升压

针对 TWS 充电仓、便携小家电这类「小电池 + 需要 5V 输出」的场景，FM9003 把 **1A 线性充电** 与 **5V/1A 同步升压** 集成到同一颗 QFN-16 封装内。

## 关键指标

- 充电电流 1A，可通过电阻编程，CV 精度 ±1%
- 升压输出 5V/1A，峰值效率 93.5%
- 静态电流 18μA，待机不掏空电池
- 外围仅需 6 个元件，BOM 面积较分立方案减少约 40%

## 评估板

FM9003 EVB 现已可申请，包含原理图、BOM 与实测波形。样片与评估板可通过「联系我们」提交需求。

详见 [FM9003 料号页](/zh/products/FM9003)。
bodyEn:
## Charging and boosting in one die

For TWS charging cases and portable appliances that pair a small cell with a 5V rail, the FM9003 combines a **1A linear charger** and a **5V/1A synchronous boost** in a single QFN-16 package.

## Key metrics

- 1A programmable charge current, ±1% CV accuracy
- 5V/1A boost output, 93.5% peak efficiency
- 18μA quiescent current keeps standby drain low
- Six external components; about 40% smaller BOM area than a discrete solution

## Evaluation board

The FM9003 EVB is available with schematics, BOM and measured waveforms. Request samples through Contact.

See the [FM9003 part page](/en/products/FM9003).

titleZh: 富满微发布 FM8001 超低噪声 LDO
excerptZh: 面向高精度传感器与 RF 前端的 17μVRMS 低噪声稳压器正式量产。
excerptEn: A 17μVRMS low-noise regulator for high-precision sensors and RF front-ends enters mass production.
bodyZh:
## 产品定位

富满微今日宣布 **FM8001** 超低噪声 LDO 正式量产。该器件在 1kHz 处提供 65dB 电源抑制比，输出噪声低至 17μVRMS，可显著降低对电源纹波敏感的模拟前端的本底噪声。

## 关键特性

- 输入电压 2.2V – 5.5V，输出电流 500mA
- 1kHz 处 PSRR 达 65dB，输出噪声 17μVRMS
- 固定输出电压版本覆盖 1.2V / 1.8V / 2.8V / 3.3V
- 采用 DFN-4 封装，适合高密度布板

## 典型应用

主要面向高精度传感器、射频前端与音频编解码供电。对噪声敏感的 ADC 参考电压链路，建议在输出端并联 10μF 陶瓷电容以进一步压低高频噪声。

> 样品现已开放申请，可通过「联系我们」提交需求。

详见 [FM8001 数据手册](/zh/products/FM8001)。
bodyEn:
## Positioning

FMW today announced mass production of the **FM8001** ultra-low-noise LDO. Offering 65dB PSRR at 1kHz and 17μVRMS output noise, it reduces baseline noise in ripple-sensitive analog front-ends.

## Key features

- Input voltage 2.2V – 5.5V, output current 500mA
- 65dB PSRR at 1kHz, 17μVRMS output noise
- Fixed-output options: 1.2V / 1.8V / 2.8V / 3.3V
- DFN-4 package, suitable for dense layouts

## Typical applications

Targeted at high-precision sensors, RF front-ends and audio codec supplies. For noise-sensitive ADC reference rails, add a 10μF ceramic capacitor at the output to further suppress high-frequency noise.

> Samples are now available — submit a request via Contact.

See the [FM8001 datasheet](/en/products/FM8001).

titleZh: FM3001 通过 AEC-Q101 车规认证
excerptZh: 30V/60A N 沟道 MOSFET 获得车规认证，正式进入车载供应链。
excerptEn: The 30V/60A N-ch MOSFET is automotive-qualified and enters the vehicle supply chain.
bodyZh:
## 认证结论

经第三方实验室全温区验证，**FM3001** 在 -40°C 至 175°C 结温范围内保持稳定的 Rds(on) 与击穿电压，正式获得 **AEC-Q101** 认证。

## 验证要点

- 全温区 Rds(on) 漂移小于 8%
- 1000 次温度循环后参数无退化
- 通过 HBM 2kV 静电放电测试

认证报告编号见料号页的「验证证据」字段，可用于车载项目的准入审查。
bodyEn:
## Certification result

Third-party full-temperature-range validation confirms that the **FM3001** maintains stable Rds(on) and breakdown voltage from -40°C to 175°C junction temperature. It is now **AEC-Q101** certified.

## Validation highlights

- Rds(on) drift below 8% across the full temperature range
- No parameter degradation after 1,000 thermal cycles
- Passed HBM 2kV ESD testing

The report reference is listed in the "verification evidence" field on the part page for automotive qualification review.

titleZh: 富满微功率器件赋能新能源
titleEn: FMW Power Devices Empower New Energy
excerptZh: 从储能 BMS 到光伏优化器，低损耗 MOSFET 与 PMIC 助力绿色转型。
excerptEn: From storage BMS to PV optimizers, low-loss MOSFETs and PMICs drive the green transition.
bodyZh:
## 方案概述

面向便携储能与快充适配器，富满微提供从 **同步整流** 到 **协议识别** 的完整器件组合，帮助客户缩短认证周期。

## 推荐组合

1. 同步整流控制器：降低次级侧损耗
2. 快充协议 IC：支持 PD / QC 多协议
3. 低静态电流 LDO：为 MCU 与采样电路供电

选型时可参考各料号页的分级验证等级：**CERTIFIED** 表示已取得第三方认证，**BENCH_TESTED** 表示已完成内部实测。
bodyEn:
## Solution overview

For portable energy storage and fast-charging adapters, FMW offers a complete device set from **synchronous rectification** to **protocol identification**, shortening certification cycles.

## Recommended combination

1. Synchronous rectification controller: lowers secondary-side losses
2. Fast-charging protocol IC: supports PD / QC
3. Low-quiescent-current LDO: powers the MCU and sensing circuits

When selecting parts, check the verification level on each part page: **CERTIFIED** means third-party certified, **BENCH_TESTED** means internally bench-verified.

titleZh: 可靠性实验室完成新一轮设备扩容
excerptZh: 新增高低温循环箱与功率器件动态测试台，覆盖 −55°C 至 175°C 全温区验证。
excerptEn: New thermal cycling chambers and a dynamic power-device test bench extend coverage from -55°C to 175°C.
bodyZh:
## 扩容内容

为支撑车规与工业级产品的验证需求，可靠性实验室本轮新增：

1. 三台高低温循环箱，温区扩展至 **−55°C ~ 175°C**
2. 功率器件动态测试台，支持双脉冲与短路耐受测试
3. 在线参数漂移监测系统，循环过程中自动记录 Rds(on) 与 Vth

## 对客户的意义

此前车规项目的全温区验证需外送第三方实验室，周期约 6 周；扩容后内部可完成大部分项目，样片验证周期缩短至 2 周以内。认证类报告仍需第三方出具。

具体的验证等级说明见各料号页的「验证证据」字段。
bodyEn:
## What was added

To support automotive and industrial qualification, the reliability lab added:

1. Three thermal cycling chambers, extending range to **-55°C to 175°C**
2. A dynamic power-device bench supporting double-pulse and short-circuit withstand tests
3. In-line parameter drift monitoring that logs Rds(on) and Vth during cycling

## What it means for customers

Full-temperature validation for automotive projects previously took about six weeks at an external lab. Most projects can now be run in-house, cutting sample validation to under two weeks. Certification reports are still issued by third parties.

See the "verification evidence" field on each part page for the verification level definitions.
